question: Who is the first captain in cricketing history to wins 13 consecutive T 20 I matches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sharma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma**, the captain of India, became the **first captain in the history of cricket to win 13 straight T20Is.**
 
• This accomplishment was made by** Rohit Sharma** in **Southampton**'s first **T20I** of a three-match series against** England.**
 
• Indian cricketer Rohit Gurunath Sharma, who was born on April 30, 1987, currently serves as the team's captain.
 
• One of the greatest opening batters in history. For his timing, eloquence, six-hitting prowess, and leadership, Rohit Sharma is renowned.
 
• In both domestic cricket and the IPL, he bats right-handedly for Mumbai Indians and Mumbai.
 
• In a single World Cup, Rohit Sharma holds the record for most 100-point performances.
 
• The Mumbai Indians, who are the most successful team in the history of the event, are also captained by Rohit Sharma in the IPL. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virat Kohli**

 
 
• Right-handed batter **Virat Kohli **competes for **Royal Challengers Bangalore in the IPL **and for Delhi in domestic cricket in India. He is a former captain of the Indian national cricket team and an international player from India.
 
• He is recognised as one of cricket's all-time great batsmen. He is second among cricket batsmen in terms of the **most hundreds scored in international play. **
 
 
 
• **Babar Azam**
 
 
• **Pakistan's national cricket** squad in all formats is captained by **Mohammad Babar Azam**, an international cricketer from **Pakistan**. He is regarded as one of the best batters in modern cricket and the only player in the world to rank in the top five in every format.
 
• He is ranked as the best batter in ODIs, fifth in Tests, and fourth in T20 Internationals.
 
 
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni**
 
 
• ​**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**, sometimes referred to as** MS Dhoni **is a former Indian cricketer who played as a **wicket-keeper**.
 
• He served as captain of the Indian national team in limited-overs forms from 2007 to 2017 and in Test cricket from 2008 to 2014. Additionally, he serves as **Chennai Super Kings' **current captain in the **Indian Premier League.**
